messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high 5xx rate from gateway-prod starting 09:12 UTC. Spike affects /v1/generate and /embed routes. Alert INC-8621.

Sam (oncall): on it. opening grafana, checking traces. 5xx jump ~18x, p95 latency up. root cause candidate: upstream 502/503 from backend pool.

Priya (sre): I see Envoy stats: `cluster.backend_pool_a.upstream_rq_5xx: 3421` and `cluster.backend_pool_a.upstream_rq_timeouts: 120` starting ~09:05. Any recent LB config changes?

Ethan (runtime): FYI we deployed edge-lb config at 09:03 that adjusted per-route retry_policy (max_retries=3) and lowered circuit_breaker thresholds for one pool to protect an overloaded region. Might be retry amplification + circuit breaker tripping.

Sam (oncall): good catch. if retries are causing amplification, we should disable retries for the affected route quickly. Can someone flip retries to 0 for /v1/generate?

Priya (sre): I can patch the ConfigMap. Applying a temporary patch to set `max_retries: 0` and increase per-try timeout to 6s to avoid premature retries. Patch command:```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap edge-lb-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/routes/generate/retry_policy/max_retries","value":0}]'
```Posting now.

Ethan (runtime): Also seeing connection failures from cluster backend_pool_a: `cx_overflow` counts rising. That suggests circuit breaker is tripping. If we disable retries but keep tight CB, we'll still see 5xx. Recommend temporarily increase `max_connections` for backend_pool_a to 1500.

Dora (pager): I'll edit the envoy cluster override to raise connection limits and remove the weight from the suspect subset to drain it. Commands I'll run:```bash
# drain bad subset by setting weight 0
kubectl -n infra patch svc edge-lb --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/paths/~1v1~1generate/weights/bad_pool","value":0}]'
# bump cb
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-cluster-overrides --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/clusters/backend_pool_a/circuit_breakers/max_connections","value":1500}]'
```Executing now.

Nora (prod): Noted customer impact: Enterprise-Corp and two other customers reported partial failures around 09:10. Support ticket #SUP-5423 opened. Keeping them updated.

Sam (oncall): After Priya's retry patch + Dora's drain + CB bump, 5xx rate dropping. Monitoring. p95 back to normal-ish in ~4m. Still seeing some backend 502s from bad_pool while draining.

Priya (sre): Confirming metrics: upstream_rq_5xx now down 85% from peak. Latency falling. The change reduced amplification by stopping retries.

Ethan (runtime): Creating emergency rollback PR to revert the new retry policy from this morning (it introduced aggressive retries under transient failures). PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-lb/pull/2898|PR#2898> please review after incident.

Dora (pager): I'll stay on follow-up and do a full health check on drained pool. Planning a controlled re-enable after we cut a safer retry config (backoff + idempotency checks).

Sam (oncall): Handing off to Dora for the postmortem and next steps. My shift ends at 10:00 UTC. Dora, can you coordinate a rollback window and postmortem notes?

Dora (pager): Yep. Initial mitigation actions summary saved to the incident ticket: disabled per-route retries, drained bad subset (weight=0), increased cb max_connections to 1500, opened rollback PR. I'll schedule a 1h window for config revert with traffic tests.

Nora (prod): Support notified affected customers with ETA for full restoration. Will follow up with incident impact summary and RCAs.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-8621 status: mitigated -> partial service restored. Severity: high -> under investigation for root cause and long-term remediation.

Sam (oncall): Good job team. Postmortem owners: Dora (lead), Priya (metrics), Ethan (runtime PR), Nora (customer comms). Closing slack thread for live warroom; we'll continue updates in the incident ticket and postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
